known_results: Original publication and V4 reanalysis findings are already known, including scale discrepancy, endpoint contrasts and pre/post DDD per item. No prospective registration claim.

modules.reproduction_bridge: Compare published monthly input scale, pre-slope, level, slope change, post-slope and terminal contrast against existing and explicitly source-aligned reconstructions. Separate data selection, units, model and estimand differences; do not invent unavailable original Stata settings or code.
modules.item_volume_decomposition: Use frozen oral presentation-month data. Split the difference in pooled pre/post DDDs per item into within-presentation quantity-per-item change and presentation item-share change using a symmetric two-period decomposition. Keep entrants and exits as separate exact contributions when a per-item ratio is undefined in one period. Present period-pool denominators, coverage and top contributors. This explains arithmetic, not individual dose, duration, adherence or packaging-policy causation.
modules.paired_log_ratio: Estimate log(DDD/items) and log(items/rows) in the original 40 months with November 2023 level/slope break, time index and 11 month indicators. OLS point estimates with Newey-West HAC covariance, lag 3 fixed as primary, finite-sample n/(n-p) correction and t residual df; lag 1 and 6 and February 2024 breakpoint as sensitivity. Exponentiate terminal contrast to percent ratio change relative to continued prior trend. Exact linear identity log(DDD/rows)=log(DDD/items)+log(items/rows) provides an implementation check. This is an exploratory ratio estimand, not a formal retest of the frozen separately fitted GLS percent contrasts. Report uncertainty and short-series limitation, all planned results, regardless of direction/significance.
modules.patient_indicators: Read official NHSBSA dashboard specifications and public access/export options. Establish age/sex population, incident/resumed/current-use definitions, temporal windows, available dates, disclosure/suppression, and drug list before any comparison. National public aggregates only. No credentials or restricted records. If matching definitions and historical coverage cannot be verified, record a feasibility limitation and do not substitute DDDs for patients.
modules.cost_feasibility: Initially query at most five national presentation-month samples: 202309, 202311, 202403, 202404, 202504. Reuse frozen explicit drug scope and source SQL API. Extract summed NIC and ACTUAL_COST alongside existing quantities and items, never multiply summed costs by ITEMS. Compare quantity/item totals to frozen inputs. Note April 2024 Actual Cost calculation discontinuity. If samples pass, full 40-month aggregate extraction and descriptive NIC/DDD plus fixed-price decomposition are permitted only if they answer the same measurement question; Actual Cost is not a causal savings outcome. No QALY, avoided-harm or net policy savings model without clinical outcomes and policy-resource data. No bulk practice-level download. Stop this module for unresolved coverage/unit/cost-definition errors. Record failure versus scientific no-go separately.

inference: Monthly observations remain the temporal units; presentation cells are aggregation components. Parallel NHSBSA representations/ADQ/patient indicators are not assumed independent validation. No claim policy is ineffective or original authors committed a specified error.
preserve: All original national aggregate data, primary models, dates and sensitivity results remain unchanged. January2022-April2025 is the40-month observation window.
scope_note: Anonymous scientific amendment copy; administrative author and project instructions omitted. Original/V4 findings were already known before these exploratory additions. No prospective registration claim.
